notes: React 18 data-table component on bench-base:node-22 (first frontend task in the suite): sorting, filtering, controlled/uncontrolled selection, grid keyboard navigation and a documented prop API. The verifier renders the deliverable under jsdom with @testing-library/react across 4 hidden prop/data fixtures (distinct datasets and prop combinations from the visible fixture), asserts DOM roles, ARIA attributes and event payloads, and strict type-checks 2 hidden consumer files against the exported prop types. All npm deps are pinned and baked into the image; no network at trial time.
